formula: G_discrete=15*G_input * sum(h*rx^2*rz^2/r^3)/sum(h*r); full symmetric122-neighbor cubic stencil, fixed weighted volume, infinitesimal affine shear used only for analytical quadrature diagnostic
scope: This is not a free-interior material experiment or a convergence study. It predicts the leading quadrature response of a full neighborhood, to be compared against the actual M2P result.
method: Taylor expansion of the unchanged independently validated LPS potential; no all-node prescribed time integration
